The '''Mountain nerf''' was a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] that was brought to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fennesa/Legends|Fennesa]]. They were descended from nerfs which had been introduced there thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] ago and had adapted to the [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] conditions there. Mountain nerfs tended to be nimbler than the varieties living on flatter terrain. The [[Fennesa Nerf Herding Council]] collected data regarding nerf [[Death/Legends|fatalities]] from various variables on the rocky planet.
